newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade volume, prices ease again.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade volume, prices ease again.

text.p: Turnover on the Latvian stock exchange fell further on Wednesday and prices in many shares also eased, the bourse said.
Overall turnover was 215,983 lats, of which secondary list stocks and leading share Unibanka made up most of the business.
Unibanka turned over 33,721 lats and was unchanged at 3.20 lats while other official list shares Staburadze and Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) fell.
RTF was down to 1.60 lats from 1.75 lats on trade of 25,670 lats while Staburadze slipped to 2.75 lats from 2.85 lats on activity of 2,015 lats.
Daugavpils Chain led the secondary list on business of 73,174 lats as it slipped to 2.10 lats from 2.15 lats while Salacgriva was stable at 4.50 lats on turnover of 44,460 lats.
The Kaija fish cannery was also stable at 1.90 lats on trade of 10,368 lats while the Latvian Bridges construction group made turnover of 6,994 lats for a seven percent fall to 92 santimes.

Other active shares included Rigas Raugs yeast plant on 3,549 lats as it slipped four santimes to 3.50 lats and the Roja fish cannery on 3,289 lats. It was one of the few risers, gaining to 2.53 lats from 2.20 lats.
